reviewMethodLimitations: Search here used web search and direct publisher/article abstracts and earlier IsoGraph source registers, not a licensed citation index or independent comprehensive database export.
Source counts are bibliographic records, not numbers of mutually inequivalent physical theories.
Search queries were field/keyword based and reference examples were examined selectively; full formal backwards/forwards citation snowballing has not been conducted.
Some existing observational-only records lack exact relational transition objects; do not infer transition dynamics from lens data.
Full equations, proof steps, counterexamples, programs, datasets, uncertainty/citation checking remain independent extraction work.
Operational full coverage must be assessed using protocol, not a chosen number of entries or mandatory priority score threshold.

technicalSourceReadiness.operationalObjectModel: typed symbols, incidence/event occurrence identity, directedness and state

technicalSourceReadiness.intervention: allowed interventions, stochastic/quantum distributions and channel types, if any
technicalSourceReadiness.mathematicalClaims: what exactly is proved under which equivalence relation, with proof/counterexample location

technicalSourceReadiness.mappingToNative: explicit model-map preservation and obstruction statement, no automatic ontology inheritance

holdNativeSimulatorEmergenceTest: Do not run broad new physics inference tests against this incomplete literature corpus. Exact source-native debugging/controls can continue if necessary, but cross-model verdict must await technical extraction/readiness gates.
externalTheoryPriorityRule: Rank relevance independently of validity. Always keep promising matches with preloaded quantum/spacetime assumptions, but never treat their outputs as proof primitive native dynamics generate those inputs.
nextReview: Full exact source technical extraction for selected high-relevance families, independent second literature source/citation passes per domain, record exclusions, saturation check and only then freeze a named corpus test version.
